title: GSAP kinetic title
description: Title whose characters rise in with a GSAP SplitText timeline. The timeline is built paused and sought from the frame, so every frame is deterministic.
props: {text: string; color?: string /*'#ffffff'*/; fontSize?: number /*120*/; fontFamily?: string /*'Inter, sans-serif'*/; staggerSeconds?: number /*0.03*/; durationSeconds?: number /*0.6*/}
example:
import {GsapKineticTitle} from './blocks/gsap-kinetic-title/GsapKineticTitle.tsx';
<GsapKineticTitle text="Ship the cut today" color="#fff" fontSize={110} />
